output.narrative: An attacker has executed an initial access attack using certutil.exe to obtain malicious resources over HTTP and Powershell scripts have been downloaded from Internet with bypassing execution policy restrictions. Scripts were run within system environments via powershell commands. Attacker also accessed credential files through 'esentutl.exe'. Attacker further escalated privileges through exploits like Invoke Atomic tests such as T1134.001. Network reconnaissance was done to identify potential targets via ARP protocol discovery and DNS queries. Multiple persistence techniques involved via registry modifications through cmd executables.
